STATES = {
 s:STATE_ALPHA = {
  create_state = { country = c:TEST owned_provinces = { xA1 xA2 } }
  add_homeland = cul_alpha
  add_claim = c:CLAIM_A
  set_variable = { name = synthetic_counter value = 1 }
 }
 s:STATE_BETA = {
  create_state = { country = c:TEST owned_provinces = { xB1 xB2 } }
  add_homeland = cul_beta
  add_claim = c:CLAIM_A
  add_claim = c:CLAIM_B
  set_variable = { name = daimyo_chain_id value = 0 }
  if = {
   limit = { var:daimyo_chain_id >= 0 }
   set_variable = { name = synthetic_counter value = 2 }
  }
 }
}
